"""Builds a priced invoice from raw order line items."""

from pricing import line_item_subtotal, apply_discount, apply_tax


class LineItem:
    def __init__(self, sku, unit_price, quantity, discount_percent=0.0):
        self.sku = sku
        self.unit_price = unit_price
        self.quantity = quantity
        self.discount_percent = discount_percent


class Invoice:
    def __init__(self, order_id):
        self.order_id = order_id
        self.line_totals = []
        self.subtotal = 0.0
        self.total = 0.0

    def add_line(self, sku, amount):
        self.line_totals.append((sku, amount))
        self.subtotal += amount


def build_invoice(order_id, items, tax_rate_percent):
    """Price every line item, applying its discount, then apply tax to the order subtotal."""
    invoice = Invoice(order_id)
    for item in items:
        subtotal = line_item_subtotal(item.unit_price, item.quantity)
        discounted = apply_discount(subtotal, item.discount_percent)
        invoice.add_line(item.sku, discounted)

    invoice.total = apply_tax(invoice.subtotal, tax_rate_percent)
    return invoice

"""Generates a plain-text billing summary for a customer order."""

from invoice import LineItem, build_invoice


def generate_report(order_id, raw_items, tax_rate_percent):
    """Turn raw order data into a customer-facing invoice summary, discounts and tax applied."""
    items = [
        LineItem(row["sku"], row["unit_price"], row["quantity"], row.get("discount_percent", 0.0))
        for row in raw_items
    ]
    invoice = build_invoice(order_id, items, tax_rate_percent)

    lines = ["Invoice for order {}".format(order_id)]
    for sku, amount in invoice.line_totals:
        lines.append("  {:<12} {:>10.2f}".format(sku, amount))
    lines.append("Subtotal: {:.2f}".format(invoice.subtotal))
    lines.append("Total (incl. tax): {:.2f}".format(invoice.total))
    return "\n".join(lines)
